transcript.content:
Now I have a clear understanding of the issue. The warning at line 2227 in `tokenization_utils_base.py` says "`max_length` is ignored when `padding`=`True`" but this is incorrect when `truncation=True` is also passed — `max_length` is still used for truncation in that case. The condition needs to also check that truncation is not active before issuing the warning.

The fix is in `src/transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py` — specifically the condition at line 2227 that determines when to raise the warning.
